svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Island shapes (9)
svg.desc: Every tetromino orientation: the seven footprints of the app plus the mirror images of the L and the S (a flipped piece would show its blank back). Seven go out each voyage. As drawn: a clean rounded outline, a thin line inside it at 4 mm, the game's island art (palms, rocks, grass edge) engraved inside the line, and a plain 6 × 2.5 mm notch in the middle of every outside edge — shallower than the line, so no cut ever meets engraving. Units: mm. 25 mm squares, 6 mm material. No kerf compensation in this file — it is a design view; cut from the sheet-N files. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
